fusions.name: Still-Pond Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps at an enemy up to 6 tiles away and deals 4 water damage, with 50% more critical hit chance against an enemy that is still unhurt.

fusions.name: Springboard
fusions.desc: Pushes off an enemy with both feet and deals 13 water damage, throwing it 3 tiles back and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Then your movement speed rises by 25% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Vanishing Ripple
fusions.desc: Veils you for 5 seconds: enemies notice you 60% later, you move 20% faster, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Crouched Ready
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next strike gains 20% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
